criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: Requests for general information about COVID-19, including what it is and its characteristics.

categories.name: Symptoms and Health Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries about symptoms, health concerns, and personal health actions related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: Questions about how COVID-19 spreads and how to prevent infection.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: Requests for information on treatment options, cures, and vaccines for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics and Data
categories.definition: Requests for statistical data, such as case numbers, death counts, and recovery rates.

categories.name: Travel and Safety Advice
categories.definition: Inquiries about travel restrictions, safety measures, and high-risk areas.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Questions addressing myths, misinformation, and conspiracy theories about COVID-19.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news and updates about COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Expressions of intent to donate or support COVID-19-related causes.

categories.name: Gratitude and Greetings
categories.definition: Expressions of gratitude, greetings, or casual conversation not seeking information.

categories.name: Sharing Information
categories.definition: Requests or intentions to share COVID-19-related information with others.
